[2023-03-01 16:21] birdman6969 : <@167634972956426240> does the goalie tandem trait improve one of the two strengths of the other goalie?  so in your case, Hjelmgren gets +2 to either endurance or positioning?
[2023-03-01 16:36] d0ghouse : So how it works is that the bonus the goalie receives is from the main strength of the other one. So in Hjelmgren's case he gets +2 to positioning, because positioning is the best skill of Redden (the backup goalie). And Redden gets either +2 to pads or gloves, because pads/gloves are the best skills of Hjelmgren.
[2023-03-01 16:37] d0ghouse : Thematically, they can improve the other goalie in skills they excel themselves at
[2023-03-01 16:46] d0ghouse : The number of pucks in a skill is the deciding factor, not talents.

There’s only about 20 teams with less than 1M cap space, that don’t have 23 or more contracts (using 23 as the number because it allows for 1 spare F/D/G for simplicity). [2023-06-23 19:48] mr.president13 : **__Wearing 'A's and Catching Strays__** This afternoon, Team USA starting goaltender took to the media to call out Team USA's management in its decision to give assistant captainship to two players who have "never worn the "A" in their career."  These comments come after a 7-4 loss to the Czech Republic; a loss that puts team USA 0-4-0 in this year's tournament, and a likely to slide back to Tier 2.   After some digging, it has been discovered that Jackson's comments towards Matt Kulas were incorrect. Kulas had worn the 'A' for his former team, the Mississauga Mighty Mites, from Season 3 to 5, and was the team's captain in much of season 6.  When asked about his thoughts on Jackson's comments, Kulas refused to comment, only sharing that the team was "going to come back strong in game 5, and do everything we can to avoid relegation."  Mr. President, the GM of the 2.2 Fredericton Firebirds, Kulas' league team, was more outspoken than Kulas about Jackson's frustrations. "First of all, Kulas, Harper, Brekke - they all know what it takes to win. They're two time world champions. Remind me, what has Lewis Jackson won on the world stage?" When asked if he thought he was being too hard on Jackson, one of the most accomplished goalies in history, Mr. President said "Jackson's a hall of famer for sure, but this year's tournament he hasn't been able to stop a beach ball. It's his job to stop the puck, he hasn't been doing that, and it's time the team sees what Keebler can do."  This year's tournament, Jackson has posted a .817 sv% and a 4.75GAA, having been pulled twice in four games. Keebler, Team USA's 25 year old backup, has yet to start a game this tournament - however has posted a .892 sv% and 1.5GAA in the two games he has played in.  Clearly, not everyone agrees on the cause of team USA's woes - but what they all appear to agree on is that a change of some sorts is needed.  *Note: at the time of writing this article, Roland Brekke was unavailable for comment.

Savić should be back next season to help out Slovenia with one of the deadlest shots in the tournament, so he's a player to keep an eye on moving forward.  __Japan: (2-2-1), -4 GD, 4th__  🇯🇵 Koichi Nomura (LD/RD): 2G 3A 5PTS +0  For Japan, their best player this tournament was Koichi Nomura, a 24 year old defenseman that looks like an extremely great defenseman for Japan. They're very young and still growing, yet putting up point-per-game numbers at this age is going to be huge for Japan in the future. Unfortunately for Japan, they fell short off a tiebreaker that would've had them in the top half had they had a better goal differential.  __Hungary: (2-2-1), -2 GD, 3rd__  🇭🇺 Benett Mate (G): 2-2-1, .914 sv%, 2.00 GA, 106 saves  Benett Mate is the MVP for Hungary as he helped carry this team on the last day to finishing 3rd place, the highest Hungary has ever finished since being a team. Mate is a young goalie who is still growing, but will close to his peak very soon. He's grabbing a bunch of experience though and all around is a very solid goalie. Hungary is going to need more goaltending like this to be able to grow, but with Mate leading the charge, there's a very big possibility that a top 3 finish next season could be a reality.  __Great Britain: (4-0-1), +15 GD, 2nd__  🇬🇧 Stanley Pidcock (RW): 3G 6A 9PTS +5  Most likely the tournament MVP, Stanley Pidcock had an unreal tournament, almost being two points on average per game. Pidcock is starting to decline though, so Great Britain most likely won't have him for much longer, however they should have him around long enough to be able to get back to Tier 3. With France promoting, Great Britain has a wide open window where they can slide up to Tier 3 next season!  __France: (5-0-0), +11 GD, 1st__  🇫🇷 Olivier Aubry: 4-0-0, .929 sv%, 2.00 GAA, 104 saves  One of the more unlikely stories at the tournament, Aubry ends up starting for France despite not being on a team for this season. Straight out of free agency, Aubry had an insane tournament, helping them secure a spot back in Tier 3 for the upcoming season. Aubry most likely won't be the starter for France next season, or in the future as he's 35, however a tournament hero for France and forever immortalized in French HN history.

[2023-09-03 22:48] d0ghouse : The import draft lets you select a player that will join your U17 as NDE player (NDE = non draft eligible, so the player will move to your U21 when he's older)
[2023-09-03 22:49] d0ghouse : You have till the end of the season to make your selection (out of 6) and then that player will join the U17 at the start of next season
[2023-09-03 22:52] d0ghouse : A random player is picked if a manager doesn't make a selection
[2023-09-03 22:54] d0ghouse : Can make your selection at the Draft Center -> Import Draft tab
[2023-09-03 22:54] australiankek : Thanks

[2024-04-06 14:15] hnadmin : These were the Banana Spots of Banana Day edition 4: 1. Joe's 'Banana Thrower' special was listed as a player special skill in the Game Guide. 2. Next to  'View your achievements' on the Leaderboard -> Achievements page. 3. The text 'The draft event takes place 50 days after Banana Day' was added to the Draft countdown on the Draft Preferences page. 4. A banana emoji was added to the topic title of the most recent forum post on the 'Recent Posts' view. 5. On the bottom of any Nation -> Amateurs page. 6. On the first card on the World Championship Tier VI page. The I in VI was a rotated banana. 7. On the title bar of your U21 Team Stats page. 8. Free Agent Banana Joe got awarded an accolade 'Top Banana Thrower'. 9. On the Forum Category 'Questions & Answers' page. Eddy 1st hint was referring to this one.  Are you kidding me? I am pretty sure they miss me. They all do. Even in Switzerland. That 👇, on the other hand, will hardly be missed. Certainly not by Europeans. Well, maybe in Sweden and Belgium.”  The first part = The Letter **Q**. All 36 nations lack this letter in their names. Even Switzerland which has the most different letters of all (11). The second part = The Letter **A**. That 👇 refers to Q pointing down to the letter A (A is below Q on keyboards with QWERTY layout). The letter 'A' is present in almost all HN nation names. The only ones missing it are Mexico, Sweden and Belgium. Sweden and Belgium being the European ones. The letters Q&A refers to Question & Answers. The clue, on top of that, starts with a question and answers it.  10. On the president Allen Lueilwitz page, the current President of the  🇺🇸  Federation. The Matching Game image that hints to this location was the White House image.

[2024-05-14 08:57] majortinkle : With imports (and general draft picks really) is there any correlation whatsoever between starting rating and potential?
[2024-05-14 09:04] furiouschicken : Gonna assume this is from a user perspective?
[2024-05-14 09:09] furiouschicken : Quickly gonna take the above screenshot for examples. Specifically Brennan Morrison. You can't fully know his potential, but what you do know is:   Shooting and face-offs won't become higher than 6 (already maxed)   The minimum any stat can have is 4 (Default minimum potential), so Skating/Endurance/Power/Passing/Defending/Discipline will at the very least be 4.  If a stat isn't maxed yet, it's potential is at least 1 higher than it's current (so Checking will be at least 5).  A player has 2 strengths, in this case Endurance and Shooting, that means the other stats can't be higher than those. From this you can learn that as Shooting is maxed at 6, that all other non-Endurance stats can't have a potential above 6 (6 is still possible). Endurance is currently 3, but will at least be 6 as it can't be lower than face-offs (a not weak stat), but could potentially (although very unlikely) be 10 (the max)  *The weakest stat (Power) will be the lowest, right now that doesn't say anything yet, outside of it being at most 6, as you don't know any other stats, but if you look at for example Denton Girard, his weakness is Shooting which is a 3 right now, but it will for sure be capped at a 4, as he has other stats capped which are 4 right now.

[2024-05-14 11:37] d0ghouse : The coaching addition this season made some changes behind the scene to how players develop. Player development is less predictable now compared to before:  > **Training System and Draft Ranking Revised** > While adding coaches, the Training System and Draft Ranking have been revised to allow for more variety in player development and less predictability. This means that on the one hand, more players will be generated that spawn with a low rating and draft ranking and grow into a star player and, on the other hand, more players will be generated that spawn with a high rating and draft ranking but do not live up to their potential. You will also notice more variety in training speed.

[2024-12-14 08:23] hnadmin : 9. Banana 9 was hinted by Clue #1:   ``` "This one is tough. If all five have it then you have it, yet nobody has it, but don't make a fuss about it.".```  This refers to the Beard Mania special which isn't unlocked yet by any user. It requires you to have five players with the Playoff Beard special. The words 'tough' and 'fuss' refer to having a tough beard and a fuzzy beard.  The banana was replacing the 0% text.   10. Banana 10 was hinted by Clue #2:   ```”He really likes his bananas. It must be the name. One of his compatriots, sitting next to him, does not. He is more of an apple person, he says. The goalie, youngest of the new group and not the smartest, then proudly tells him that he bought a new Mac. Whereupon the Dutchman, chuckling in a corner, says that he of course prefers oranges. Rocky, the  joker of the group, gets the group roaring when he concludes with 'Luckily for them there's no Kiwi playing'.”``` I had fun making this one. Rocky refers to Rocky Gislason who was invited to the Banana All Stars team, a new group that played against the Banana Old Stars that had no players from New Zealand. The Dutchman refers to Ruben Fluitsma and the goalie refers to Adam Suchý, the youngest player on the team. But most importantly, Joe Beukeboom, who kind of shares a name with Banana Joe, was also on the Banana All Stars team. The banana was placed at his player page replacing the letter J of Joe.
